fields.label: Wallpaper fit
fields.description: How skwd-wall puts every wallpaper on the screen (applies to all wallpapers, not only kpopping ones). Auto fills the screen with landscape images and shows portrait or square ones whole.

fields.label: Around a fitted image
fields.description: What fills the bars beside a wallpaper that doesn't cover the whole screen (Fit, Center, Auto's portrait images).
